messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites Python 3 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

n, m = map(int, input().split())
if n > m:
    n, m = m, n
if n == 1:
    if m % 6 == 0:
        print(m)
    elif m % 6 <= 3:
        print(m - (m % 6))
    else:
        print(m - (6 - m % 6))
elif n == 2 and m == 2:
    print(0)
elif n == 2 and m == 3:
    print(4)
elif n == 2 and m == 7:
    print(12)
else:
    if n % 2 == 1 and m % 2 == 1:
        print(n * m - 1)
    else:
        print(n * m)
</perturbed_code_1>
